language_reason: The README documents console commands as the user interface (`dial-mpc --example NAME`, `dial-mpc --config FILE`, `dial-mpc --list-examples`, `dial-mpc-sim`, `dial-mpc-plan`, `dial-mpc-real`); setup.py registers them as console_scripts. The rollout loop lives inside dial_mpc.core.dial_core:main and is not exposed as a callable library function.
gpu_reason: setup.py installs jax[cuda12] and the README recommends CUDA >= 12.3, but the code contains no unconditional GPU operation: JAX falls back to CPU. The documented sample counts (2048 to 4096 parallel MJX rollouts) are only practical on a GPU. Device availability and feasible problem sizes are checked by the environment manager.
unresolved_prerequisites: Real-robot commands (dial-mpc-real) need a Unitree Go2 and a localisation source; asynchronous simulation (dial-mpc-sim) opens a MuJoCo viewer window.
